conviction_note: The FY8/2026 miss against the unrevised company guide is nearly certain (OP about 3,550-3,700 vs 4,025; the guide needs Q4 OP +81% YoY), and October prints fell -7.0% and -5.3% the last two years on the same 'missed again' headline. But the street's one IFIS consensus already sits at the miss (OP 3,550), holders on the board openly expect a bad print, and a lowered consensus is easier for the habitually aspirational FY27 guide to clear, so the miss is sized at only -1.0. Small offsets in both directions net to -1.0.
bar: Company full-year guide FY8/2026, unrevised since 2025-10-01 and reaffirmed 2026-06-29: sales 18,000 / OP 4,025 / ordinary 4,200 / NI 2,900 (JPY m), https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7447 and Q3 短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260629/140120260626582112.pdf. Expected FY OP of about 3,550-3,700 is roughly -10% against this guide. Against the IFIS consensus (OP 3,550 / ordinary 3,700, a single source with no second estimate to confirm it, https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report&bcode=7447) the print is expected roughly in line, about 0% to +3%. The real driver is the FY8/2027 guide and dividend, for which no sourced bar exists, so every size here is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% with no disclosed seller at or above 0.5%, change 0.0 (baseline, as of 2026-09-29, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html), so there is no short-squeeze fuel. Margin (kabutan weekly 信用残, https://kabutan.jp/stock/kabuka?code=7447&ashi=shin): margin shorts fell from 79,500 (8/14) to 9,800 (9/25) as the dividend-record hedges unwound. Margin longs rose from 142,700 to 178,700, about 2.5 days of volume. So the 18.23 信用倍率 in the baseline mostly reflects the cross unwinding, not a newly crowded long. Large-holder reports: Fidelity group went 9.30% -> 8.70% (7/15) -> 7.34% (8/31), selling about 600k shares while the company's ¥1bn buyback (565k shares) absorbed it; the buyback finished 2026-08-12. There is no option market and no skew.

findings.finding: FY8/2026 will miss the never-revised company guide by roughly 10% at OP. The guide implies Q4 (Jun-Aug) sales of 4,733 (+31% YoY) and OP of 1,212 (+81% YoY), and Q4 OP has been only 668-872 in recent years. This is the third straight year of missing guidance, and kabutan/FISCO will headline it as 下振れ着地 exactly as they did on 2025-10-02.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The October full-year prints with a miss vs guide were -7.02% (2024-10-02) and -5.28% (2025-10-02, '一転営業減益で着地し失望売り'; FY25 OP 35.8 vs guide 40.8, plus an FY26 guide below the 41.5 consensus). The two Q3 prints with capital returns were +9.38% and +6.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, which is why this is sized at a quarter of the historical reaction. The 9M progress of 70.4% vs a 79.3% five-year average and the implied Q4 +74.7% were published by kabutan on 2026-06-29, IFIS consensus sits at OP 3,550 (-12% vs guide), and the board says '10/1の決算最悪って事で、また売られている'. The part that is not priced is the headline mechanic: a retail-held dividend name reacts to 'missed guidance' against the company number, not against IFIS, and that happened last year when a similar 71.7% 9M progress preceded the -5.3% print.
findings.independence: Same arithmetic in the Q3 短信 (guide unchanged, 'no revision', https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260629/140120260626582112.pdf) and the FISCO memo saying '達成は容易ではない' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7447&b=n202607240624). These are three readings of one set of numbers and count once. The 2025 precedent is a separate document: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7447&b=n202510020516

findings.finding: The FY8/2027 guide has a lowered bar to clear. The company has guided double-digit OP growth from a down year before (FY26 initial +12.3%), and it is carrying a rolled-over mid-term plan of FY8/2028 OP 4.7bn, which implies roughly +13% a year from a ~3.6bn base. The Feb-2026 price hike runs for a full year, and the June 2026 診療報酬 +3.09% revision lands in FY27. A habitual +10-15% guide would therefore print above the IFIS street (~flat FY26, OP 3,550).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2025-10-01 a +12.3% OP guide still fell 5.3% because it was below the 41.5 consensus (FISCO, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7447&b=n202510020553). On 2024-10-01 a ~+2% guide was followed by -7.0%. This line has not been rewarded in either sample year.
findings.why_not_priced: IFIS consensus for FY26 was cut to OP 3,550 and its rating reads 弱気 against the company. If the market expected another +12% guide to be credible, the stock would not sit at 16.9x a guided EPS it knows will be missed. The risk is that, after three misses, the market discounts the guide entirely. That is why this is small.
findings.independence: The FY26 price-hike and 診療報酬 tailwinds are in the Q3 短信 qualitative section (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260629/140120260626582112.pdf). The FY27 guide figure itself is an inference, with no document giving it.

findings.finding: The buyback bid is gone and the largest active holder is selling. Fidelity group cut from 9.30% to 7.34% between 7/15 and 8/31 (about 600k shares), and the ¥1bn buyback that absorbed it finished on 2026-08-12. No new authorization has been filed, and last year's post-results buyback came on 11/12, not with the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When a buyback was announced with the print (2026-06-29) the stock rose +7.0% on the day. In 2025 no buyback came with the FY print, and the stock fell 5.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock has drifted from 1,712 to 1,632 since ex-dividend (-4.7%). The large-holding report is on EDINET, not in the baseline's positioning arm, which reads 0 shorts and a margin ratio inflated by the dividend-cross unwind. A seller still working out of 7.34% with no buyback behind it is supply into whatever headline lands. If the market had priced a new buyback at the print, the post-ex-div drift would not have been steady downward.

outside_window.finding: The TOPIX reform free-float/market-cap screen is likely to phase this ¥50bn name out, with staged index selling through 2028. This is a holder claim on the Yahoo board and is not confirmed by JPX.
